label: Whatever is in POTENCY_1 in some respect is in act as to being and could lack being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred (potency clause): if x is in potency in some respect r in the adopted sense POTENCY_1 (it can be so in r and is not in act in r, DEF-POTENCY), then x is in act as to being and could lack being (Lackability.CanLack x esse, definition 56b438a0-7fcc-4dd5-916b-1d2e2162310b). It is the potency counterpart of the lackable-being bridge 6e2176cd-eeb6-413c-8fd2-7b2df4a34ad4 (which starts from an act x could lack). Nearest existing material: d8024a38-5d93-4c1d-8c21-fdbfa87a5cde (in act as to being and in potency in some respect implies composite, for the free POTENCY_2 parameter); passing from composite to 'could lack being' and from POTENCY_2 to POTENCY_1 is not formalized. It is about the beings in the domain: it also makes whatever is in potency in act as to being. Rival: a necessary being with unrealized potencies, as in dipolar theism (Hartshorne's distinction of necessary existence from contingent actuality; not read, navigation only), denies it; its price is the composition thesis. Not assessed here.
